description.value: Chieftain Pool & Pinball is a smoke-free bar on Cleveland Avenue in Squamish offering pool tables and pinball machines in an indoor-only setting. Squamish is a major hub for mountain biking, road cycling, and multi-day touring, making this a natural stop for cyclists seeking indoor downtime. The bar's game-focused atmosphere sets it apart from typical pubs in the area.
